title: hypericum quadrangulum f. undulatum
intro: Hypericum quadrangulum f. undulatum, commonly known as the wrinkled St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant species within the St. John's Wort genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in stress relief, anxiety, and insomnia, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum quadrangulum f. undulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phenolic glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter activity and exert antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
